about: Worked examples of the context reading every gglib client draws. gglib reports the counts; a client applies this rule and nothing else. Replayed by gglib tests/ts and copied into ggchat as a fixture; change the rule here first.

rule.source: The newest reply decides, whether or not it carries figures. Only a reply marked incomplete that carries neither count is passed over. Counts are never summed across replies or model calls.
rule.shown: Only when prompt_tokens, completion_tokens and a context_size above zero are all present. No estimate, and never the model list context_window.
rule.percent: min(100, (200 * used + context_size) / (2 * context_size)) in whole-number division: round half up
rule.numbers: Shown here with en-US grouping; a client may use its own locale for the digits and keeps the words.
